description: This file defines a Spring Boot REST controller providing basic endpoints for the application, including welcome, documentation redirect, health check, and info endpoints.

classes.name: HelloController
classes.description: A REST controller providing basic service endpoints for welcome message, documentation redirection, health check, and application info.

methods.name: hello
methods.description: Returns a welcome message string when the root URL is accessed.

methods.name: docs
methods.description: Redirects clients to the Swagger UI documentation page.

methods.name: health
methods.description: Provides a basic health check endpoint returning 'OK'.
